newsitem.title: EGYPT: Nile tourist cruiser in accident, 20 feared drowned.
newsitem.headline: Nile tourist cruiser in accident, 20 feared drowned.

text.p: A cruise boat carrying mainly Czech and Slovak tourists suffered an accident on the Nile in southern Egypt on Thursday and at least 20 people are missing and feared drowned, security sources said.
Security sources said the boat, named as the Amira Jihan, was carrying 83 tourists and sank in the river near the town of Edfu, about 600 miles (360 miles) south of the capital Cairo.

"We think that while the captain was trying to dock the boat along the shore, the boat tipped over because of the strong wind," said one policeman in the tourist resort of Aswan, the provincial capital.

The Interior Ministry in Cairo said the boat only ran aground. It was carrying 61 Czechs, 14 Slovaks and an unknown number of Egyptians, a ministry spokesman said. It was not yet clear how many people were missing.
The security sources in the south said 60 people had been rescued from the boat and had been taken to Edfu hospital.
